title: The Snackrooms
physical_identity: Infinite 1980s-style mall cafeteria of restaurants and bars with navy tables, free vending machines and skylights showing darkness but lit like daylight.
scale_topology: Infinite indoor mall halls; restaurant pockets; exits of restaurants may lead to other restaurants.
anomalies: Skylights show darkness yet daylight lighting
Restaurant exits lead to other restaurants
lighting_sound: Constant daylight-equivalent light from skylights; orange-white windows; speaker music mostly 80s/90s hits.

entities.name: Shape-shifting Guild impostors
entities.behavior: TESTIMONY: unzip into giant-mouthed tentacled forms and massacre guards

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Facelings (friendly); hostile entities only via incident logs
items_communities: Almond Water, Cashew Water, distilled water

entrances.method: Trip on a wire and noclip through floor
entrances.quote: Trip on a wire in Level 6 unintentionally.

entrances.method: Press any button on vending machine and noclip in
entrances.quote: you will be teleported to a random location within Level 6.1 .

exits.quote: Constantly guarded by The M.E.G. and access to this exit without permission is restricted.
This exit is the safest and easiest way to exit Level 6.1 .
Entering through any vent opening will cause you to be sucked into the vent and dropped into Level 3 .
Finding a wall that is unnaturally bent and entering it can lead you to The Blue Channel .

signature_mechanic: Safe infinite mall food court with free food and weekly restocks, restaurants that reconnect to other restaurants, rare blue-glow expansion events.
conflicts_notes: Infobox class is empty. Says five exits but fifth bullet is a plea, not a route. Level 122, 1.5, Level Fun, Entity 67, 6.2 in links only. Second exploration log truncated. Incident Report-4 not on page.

key_quotes.quote: The vending machines in Level 6.1 can produce small snacks and drinks without any payment
A glass sky light can be seen on the top of most ceilings on this area, but shows nothing but darkness.
No hostile Entities in Level 6.1 spawn naturally
